scope: en-05 setup (A Korean 949x data, B English); A exe with the VK_PACKET fix: trace build (y9) and release build sha256 1c47afe38fdfbb69d5cf1e2687482a3993ba4cf6fc9e341caf27cddef9c0c2e0 (y10). Chat typed with SendInput Unicode at 150 ms.
observation: Cause: trace y5 shows CInputMan+0x24 becoming 1 for about 1.5 s right after 하 was typed; static reading shows that field is a lock counter changed only by 0xB916D0, called when the room item box opens (0xB912E0 from the key-binding handlers 0xD5AA60 and siblings, command 6 from 0x1229450(vk, lParam)). VK_PACKET keydowns carry the character in HIWORD(lParam), which the binding lookup reads as a scan code. With the hook translating VK_PACKET keydowns itself and passing WM_NULL to the game, the lock no longer appears (y9 trace) and the service received the whole strings: 'Xin chào các bạn 안녕하세요 ạ' (33 bytes, y9) and '안녕하세요 반갑습니다 하세요' (28 bytes, y10), both previously cut at 26 and 10 bytes.
cleanup: Raw export passed for both runs.
limits: Diagnostic exe and service on Wine; SendInput Unicode typing (as Unikey) only, real Korean IME composition not exercised. The game no longer sees VK_PACKET key events, which it does not need for text.
